slides.title: RLS Career Overhaul v2.8.0.1
slides.subtitle: Drag Racing Update
slides.summary: Street drags, sanctioned drag weekends, a new fuel system and a round of fixes.

slides.title: No Prep Knights
slides.summary: Join the Knights through Car Meets and race for cash or pink slips after dark.
facts: Cash races and a five-boss pink-slip ladder
Talk a boss into a race your car can't match on value
Defend your title once the ladder is done
Meets every two to four days, invites at any hour
Watch out for police raids at closing time

slides.title: Sanctioned Drags
slides.summary: Scheduled drag weekends at the Alder strip, booked from a new phone app.
facts: Daily offers from Pro League, SLRA and Street Kings
Register, pass inspection and run three qualifiers
Race seeded elimination brackets for cash prizes
Timeslips on the Event display after every pass
Clear spectator cameras from paddock to finish

slides.title: Fuel & Ignition
slides.summary: Tune mixture, timing, boost and decel, and pick the fuel your engine runs on.
facts: Simple dials or a full Advanced map
Flex-fuel, methanol and nitromethane conversions
Injector and pump upgrades show the power you gain
E85 at every West Coast gas station
Pay once at the pump when you leave
Boost override is now opt-in

slides.title: Stronger builds. Fewer surprises.
slides.summary: Shared drag hardware, a better dyno and fixes across your career.
facts: Shared Stage 4 drag blocks and pulley choices
Race and drag tires need heat before full grip
Dyno load presets and your tune gains are kept
Car-meet pink slips accept a slightly quicker car
Failed saves no longer lock Exit or reload
Fixes for taxis, repairs, business pulls and Linux saves
